elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Your iPhone has a secret button on the back.

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn on Back Tap.

[friendly] Go to Settings, Accessibility, Touch, Back Tap. Pick Double Tap. Choose an action, like Screenshot or Flashlight.

[delighted] Two taps on the back, done.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
